dataset.note: Curated golden set; DE stratum authored + adversarially verified. Production config (few-shot exemplars on). Hallucination heuristic covers EN items only.

notes: 2026-07-18: golden set grown 80->100 (20 urgency-boundary items, 12 EN / 8 DE, adversarially verified by two independent auditors; 4 label corrections applied from their disputes and the harness's grounding invariant). A churn-musing calibration exemplar was added. The urgency exemplar effect is now statistically significant: 82%->90% in-run paired McNemar p=0.021 (was p=0.219 at n=80). EN urgency 91.7% (was 86.7%).

Sentiment accuracy is run-to-run noisy on mixed-vs-polar boundary items: two same-day runs of this config scored 99% and 96%; the in-run paired A/B (off 98% -> on 96%, p=0.5) shows the exemplar change is not the cause. Reported as measured, not re-run for a better number.

Tag metrics are NOT comparable to the 2026-07-17 snapshot: the 20 new items introduce fresh vocabulary and deliberately adversarial boundaries, and exact-tag agreement wobbles across runs at temperature 0. The designed inference remains the in-run A/B (7%->24%, p=0.001).
